reference.title: Credentials Preferences
reference.shortdesc: The stored credentials are shown in the Credentials preferences page.

section.title: Overview
section.p: Open the Git Client preferences page, then select the Credentials page. It lists the HTTP and token credentials that the Git Client has stored for Git servers.

property.propdesc: The Git server host for which credentials are stored.
The stored authentication type, such as Personal access token or Basic authentication.
The username associated with basic authentication credentials, when available.

property.propvalue: Disabled until an entry is selected
property.propdesc: Removes the selected stored credentials after you apply the preferences changes. To remove credentials for multiple servers, select multiple rows before selecting Remove.
